shared_elements: upright slab/monolith with rounded top carved in relief
curved arcing bands crossing the surface
relief motifs confined to a single vertical field
justification: The only real correspondence in depicted content is generic: each shows a tall rounded-topped stone whose face carries low-relief motifs including a ring/disc and sweeping curved bands arranged vertically down the centre. Otherwise the content diverges sharply — B depicts a dense figural programme (quadrupeds, a mounted or seated figure, panels of geometric ornament) framed by continuous plaited interlace, while A shows only a few sparse, highly schematic abstract elements (a ring above crossed arcs) with no creatures, no figures and no border pattern.
